description: Get detailed information about a Memorystore for Valkey backup collection.

name.description: Required. Instance backupCollection resource name using the form: `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}/backupCollections/{backup_collection_id}` where `location_id` refers to a Google Cloud region.

name: get_backup_collection

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the backup collection was created.

instance.description: Output only. The full resource path of the instance the backup collection belongs to. Example: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}

instanceUid.description: Output only. The instance uid of the backup collection.

kmsKey.description: Output only. The KMS key used to encrypt the backups under this backup collection.

lastBackupTime.description: Output only. The last time a backup was created in the backup collection.

name.description: Identifier. Full resource path of the backup collection.

totalBackupCount.description: Output only. Total number of backups in the backup collection.

totalBackupSizeBytes.description: Output only. Total size of all backups in the backup collection.

uid.description: Output only. System assigned unique identifier of the backup collection.
